_readme: aliases  — the SAME screen named differently on each platform. Key is the app
route, value is the website route. These are not gaps.
ignore   — routes that are not features at all (auth, dashboards, route groups).
webOnly / appOnly — screens that deliberately exist on one platform, with the
reason. Anything not listed anywhere is treated as accidental drift.
Adding an entry is a decision. Write the reason as if explaining it in six months.

webOnly.admin/finance/import: CSV/Excel upload needs a desktop file picker and a wide preview table. Not practical on a phone.
webOnly.admin/finance/budget/edit: Dense multi-row budget editing. Belongs on a large screen.
webOnly.admin/settings/pricing: Rarely changed, and changing a price is a considered act — desktop only is deliberate.
webOnly.admin/finance/debtors: Shipped as DebtorsTab inside the app finance screen. A tab is not a missing feature.
webOnly.admin/dogs/:id/pedigree/print: A4 print stylesheet. Printing from a phone is not a workflow anyone has.
webOnly.portal/dogs/:id/pedigree/print: A4 print stylesheet. Printing from a phone is not a workflow anyone has.
webOnly.portal/register: The app uses native auth; this is a browser-only account-creation flow.
webOnly.portal/verify-code: The app uses native auth; email/OTP confirm is a browser-only flow.
webOnly.portal/invite-expired: Browser landing for a dead invite link. The app never opens that URL.
webOnly.portal/auth/confirm: Supabase email-confirm redirect for the website. The app handles the session natively.
webOnly.admin/training/videos: Shipped as the Videos tab on the app training dashboard. A tab is not a missing feature.
webOnly.admin/finance/invoices/recurring/:id: Pause, resume and end already live on the app recurring-invoice list. The website detail page is more room, not a missing capability.

appOnly.portal/add-photos/:dogId: Owners photograph their dog on a phone. The website equivalent is the upload control on the portal dog page, not a separate screen.
appOnly.admin/breeding/organogram: Pan/zoom pedigree tree built with native gestures. A web version needs its own approach, tracked in PARITY_5.
appOnly.admin/notifications: Push notification inbox is a device concept; the website uses the same data on the dashboard.
appOnly.admin/settings/quote-lapse: Shape difference, not a gap. The app gave lapse settings a dedicated screen; the website put the same fields on general Settings.
appOnly.admin/finance/proofs: Payment-proof inbox is a phone workflow. The website reviews the same rows on the dashboard and on each quote.
appOnly.admin/training/:id: Booking detail. The website TrainingManager handles it inline on the training dashboard; a phone needs its own screen.
